lines.zh: 骨头爪子敲在地上，哒哒。
lines.en: Bone claws click on the ground.

lines.zh: 我这身皮肉都没了，只剩架子。
lines.en: No flesh left — just a frame.
My joints clack as I walk.
I still remember how wolves walk.
No nose left; I hunt by sound.
My ribs show in the wind.
I follow the breath of the living.
My tail is a chain of bone.
A skeleton's body is light.
I don't breathe, so I make no sound.

lines.zh: 这本该是森林里的脚步。
lines.en: These were forest footsteps once.
I circle, looking for stragglers.
I stand, bones utterly still.
Nothing in my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 我数着风从第几根肋骨穿过。
lines.en: I count which rib the wind slips through.
I remember being alive.
No muscles means no fatigue.
I tilt my skull to listen.
Ants crawl over my bones.
This frame won't fall apart.
I click my teeth together.
No breath, no warmth.

lines.zh: 你活着，我闻不出来，但看得出。
lines.en: You're alive — I can't smell it, but I see it.

lines.zh: 我的眼眶里没有眼睛，也在看你。
lines.en: No eyes in these sockets, and still I watch.
Your warmth has an outline.
Don't grin at my bones.
I was a wolf once.
I hear your heartbeat.
I lower my skull and sniff the air.
You're not even a little afraid.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，吓到你了吧。
lines.en: This look of mine frightens you.
Bone endures more than flesh.
A bone broke; it doesn't hurt.
Half of me scattered; I put it back.
No flesh, so the wound is clean.
I retreat with a clack.
That force won't scatter me.
A bone flew off.
My whole frame sways.
I died once; I'm not afraid.
The crack of bone is brittle.
I keep coming.
Meat? I don't even have a stomach.
Throw me a bone instead.
I can't taste that anymore.

lines.zh: 我只对还在喘气的感兴趣。
lines.en: I care only for things still breathing.
You hold out meat; I feel nothing.
I can't smell it; wasted effort.

lines.zh: 骨头，我只对骨头有兴趣。
lines.en: Bones — only bones interest me.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，什么都没有。
lines.en: I open my jaw; nothing there.
Temptation does nothing to bone.
Put it down; I won't eat it.
Bone knocks bone with a crack.
A rib came loose.
I'm light; a bump tips me.
I straighten up with a rattle.
You walked into my ribcage.
I pull back; bones hold.
A dead thing doesn't mind a bump.
My claws scraped you.
Don't push; I'll come apart.
I set all four legs straight again.
Living wolves won't have me.
How does one get close with bones?
I only remember the feeling.
At night I howl alone.
No warmth; I can't get close.
My kin are all in the earth.
My howl gets no answer.
Loneliness is nothing new.
I lie in the open and imagine company.
The living should live well.

lines.zh: 我用牙咬起来，骨头很硬。
lines.en: I bite it up; bone is hard.
This doesn't even count as bone.
I carry it; it clatters.
Dropped — my paws can't grasp.
I lower my skull and nudge it.
A bone — like one of mine.
I carry it to my den.
No tongue to lick it with.
I pick up a bone and stuff it in my jaw.
No hands; my teeth will do.

lines.zh: 活物的气味，虽然我闻不到。
lines.en: Living prey, though I can't smell it.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的每粒石子我都听着。
lines.en: I hear every pebble you crush.
The instinct in these bones remains.
I drop my skull as low as it goes.
You're tonight's prey.

lines.zh: 脚步一响，我的头骨就转向你。
lines.en: A footstep sounds and my skull swings toward you.
I've got you inside my gaze.
My teeth click.
No panting — only footsteps.
I circle to your rear flank.
These bones can still bite.
My teeth are already set.

lines.zh: 你的影子在动，我看得见。
lines.en: Your shadow moves; I see it.
Tonight's hunt begins.
I remember what hunger feels like.
I trail you, limping.
I don't tire; you do.
Bones don't pant.

lines.zh: 我贴在你的影子里，一步不远。
lines.en: I stay inside your shadow, never a step behind.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把这段距离磨掉。
lines.en: Step by step, I grind the distance away.
My teeth stay bared.
You've backed against the stone.
My claws scrape the stone.
I could run this chase all day.
The more you panic, the steadier I am.

lines.zh: 骨头蹭着草叶，离你更近了。
lines.en: Bone rasps through the grass, closer to you.

lines.zh: 别指望这几根骨头会累。
lines.en: Don't expect these bones to tire.
The rattle of bones is the countdown.
No path ahead.
My snout is nearly at you.
One more bound and I'm there.
Do you hear my teeth?

lines.zh: 扑上去之前，我总会停一下。
lines.en: I always pause before the leap.
My jaws clamp shut!
Bone teeth are sharp too.
One swipe, three furrows.
I leap — light as a dead thing.
Don't put your arm up.

lines.zh: 我的咬合没有力气，却有重量。
lines.en: My bite has no muscle, but it lands.
That was bone on bone.
One bite, then half a step back.
Two bites, and my jaw stays shut.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，什么味道也没有。
lines.en: I bite down and taste nothing at all.
That bite reminds me of living.
Once shut, I don't plan to open.
A tooth chips — no matter.
Next bite aims for the throat.
I don't fear pain; you do.
Fall already; don't drag it out.

lines.zh: 土里爬出来，我抖了抖骨头。
lines.en: I claw out of the soil and rattle.
Under the moon, a skeleton rises.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，自己都陌生。
lines.en: Even I find this shape strange.
First, shake off the dirt.

lines.zh: 眼眶里空空，看得很清楚。
lines.en: Empty sockets see quite clearly.
Living things here.
I turn my skull all the way round.
My bones rasp softly.
No breathing means no warning.
I stand — taller than I expected.
Who woke me from the soil?

lines.zh: 我慢慢走向有声音的地方。
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the sound.
The wind sets my ribs rattling.
The world is still this bright.
Fire crackles on my bones.
I fall; ribs scatter on the dirt.

lines.zh: 水泡着骨头，我又沉又冷。
lines.en: Water soaks my bones; I sink, cold.

lines.zh: 炸得我整副架子都散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters my whole frame.

lines.zh: 箭射穿肩胛，骨头缺了一块。
lines.en: An arrow punches through my shoulder blade and chips the bone.

lines.zh: 那股力量，扯着我的骨头。
lines.en: That force pulls at my bones.

lines.zh: 会饿的那个肚子，早没了。
lines.en: The belly that once hungered is long gone.

lines.zh: 雷穿过骨头，我全身发亮。
lines.en: Lightning runs through my bones.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，骨头一块块散开。
lines.en: I fall, bones coming apart.
